summary.headline: PI Industries FY26 revenue ₹67,137 mn with ~25% EBITDA margin; Q4 revenue ₹15,652 mn up sequentially, FY27 guided to growth led by H2 exports recovery.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 revenue was ₹15,652 mn, up sequentially as guided last quarter, and FY26 consolidated revenue was ₹67,137 mn with a stated 25% EBITDA margin and ₹34,265 mn cash. AgChem exports declined on lower volumes amid a global downcycle, while domestic demand was hit by channel inventory, price pressure, and lower acreages. Management guided to revenue growth in FY27, with exports recovering in H2, but declined to give a specific growth number or margin guidance beyond maintaining last year's average gross margin. Pharma grew 40% for the year and biologicals are targeted to scale, with the first homegrown NCE (Pioxaniliprole) nearing market.

financial_highlights.change: 3-year CAGR growth cited; no YoY % stated
sequential growth, in line with prior-quarter guidance
management says delivered committed resilient margin
expanded per management; analyst cited 58-59% range
Q4 ETR rose on higher non-SEZ sales; FY27 and after expected to inch up to 24%

financial_highlights.value: ~₹700 mn as of March 2026 (down from ~₹1,000 mn in Dec 2025)
financial_highlights.change: reduction of ~30-35% cited; still above ~₹400 mn in March 2025

segments.name: AgChem Exports (CSM)
segments.commentary: Export decline driven by lower volumes from global industry contraction and customer delivery schedules; 5 new molecules commercialised, new products now 18% of AgChem exports. Largest product (pyroxasulfone, a partnership product) dominates exports; realisation fell ~5% per analyst.

segments.name: Domestic Agri Brands
segments.commentary: Demand hit by channel inventory, pricing pressure, delayed regulatory transitions for biologicals, and lower crop acreages; 4 new launches in FY26 (3 herbicides, 1 insecticide). Management expects momentum to pick up with stronger Kharif.

segments.name: Pharma (PIHS)
segments.commentary: Revenue grew 40% in FY26 on strategic customer onboarding; still not EBITDA positive, with management pointing to ₹500-600 crore top line as the threshold, likely a couple of years or more away.

segments.name: Global Biologicals / AgSciences
segments.commentary: Compounding at over 20% in recent years; first-of-its-kind foliar nematode product launched in Brazil and Mexico, US is third market; management expects Brazil sales to more than triple this year. Break-even expected in a couple of years with heavy market-building spend in FY27.

segments.name: Electronic Chemicals
segments.commentary: Early stage, not significant to topline; 4-5 products in development. Target about $80-100 mn revenue in 5-6 years; ~$100 mn target in 4-5 years cited earlier. Management says a few hundred crore of additional gross block planned.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth expected, led by AgChem export recovery in H2 FY27, new domestic launches (including first homegrown NCE) and pharma and biologicals scale-up.
Worst-case FY27 growth guided at late single digit to early double digit; management declined to give a normal-case number.
Gross margin: management intends to maintain FY26 average gross margin (~58%); no EBITDA margin guidance given, citing volatility.
ETR expected to inch up to 24% from FY27 onward (FY26: 22%).

Capex of ₹700-800 crore for FY27 across manufacturing, launches, and R&D in pharma and agrochemicals. Extra R&D and launch spend of ₹50-100 crore expected in FY27, with heavy market-building costs for global products.
Contract assets to stay within ~₹500-700 crore range going forward.
capex_capacity: FY26 capex about ₹1,100 crore, mainly agrochemicals and R&D; pharma capex about ₹91 crore (₹100 crore odd).
Kilo facility at Lodi plant about to be commercialised; Flow MPP commissioned in FY26; kilo facilities to fire up this year for pharma pipeline.
Capex over last three years about ₹2,600 crore per analyst; asset turns fell from ~2.5x to ~1.5x per analyst's calculation, management attributed to long multi-year ramp-ups and soft R&D/NCE spend.
Pharma GMP facility needs upgrade for CDMO; investment in KSM capabilities planned.
demand_pricing: Global crop protection in multi-year downcycle; just-in-time purchasing shift; Middle East conflict since late February 2026 added disruption.
Domestic demand muted by elevated channel inventory, lower crop prices, incessant rainfall; Rabi season good with higher acreages.
Pricing corrections and currency movements affecting exports; pass-through models in place; raw material volatility cited as having impact.
Management prioritising market share and volume over margin.
Raw material availability is a constraint across the sector, not fully in company control.
Order book around $1-1.2 billion (company-level, not split by segment).

qa_highlights.question: Why has capex of ~₹2,600 crore over three years not converted into revenue, with asset turns down to ~1.5x?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said investments are for multi-year ramp-ups (four to five years for new molecule capacity), some in technology, NCEs and regulatory work with longer gestation; some assets come online in the coming year and next couple of years.

qa_highlights.question: What is FY26 growth excluding the largest product in CSM exports?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said new molecules are about 18% of the portfolio and growing faster; other new molecules are growing but below expected rates given the external environment.

qa_highlights.question: Will contract assets fall further?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said contract assets fell ~30-35% from December 2025 and will hover around ₹500-700 crore given the business model, inventory needs and supply-chain volatility.

qa_highlights.question: What is the margin outlook for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it will maintain the average gross margin of last year (~58%), but would not give a specific EBITDA margin view given volatility in input costs.

qa_highlights.question: What FY27 growth is possible in the worst case?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said late single digit to early double digit growth at worst case; declined to size the normal case, citing the volatile environment.

qa_highlights.question: What is the pharma path to EBITDA breakeven?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the business needs ₹500-600 crore top line to turn EBITDA positive, targeted within two to three years with an accelerated J-curve after that.

qa_highlights.question: Can the NCE Pioxaniliprole be out-licensed and when?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it will look to file outside India around end of this year or next year, with strategic partnerships to be announced when decisions are final.

risks_watch: Patent expiry / genericisation of the largest CSM product, with management declining to give a decline trajectory.
Raw material availability and input cost volatility; no EBITDA margin guidance for FY27.
Asset turn decline and long gestation of new investments (pharma, electronic chemicals, biologicals).
Heavy FY27 spend on global biologicals market-building and NCE launch, which may weigh on opex.
Pharma CRDMO investment appetite and biotech funding reduction; pharma remains far from EBITDA breakeven.
Founder-level change: JMD Rajnish Sarna stepped down from executive roles including IR; Group CFO takes over investor engagement.
summary.management_tone: Cautious on near-term visibility, repeatedly declining to quantify FY27 growth, margins, or product-level trajectories due to volatility, while being upbeat on long-term NCE, biologicals, and pharma positioning. Management frequently answered with qualifiers and deferred specifics to later quarters.
key_quotes: Our consolidated revenue for the full year FY26, we have delivered revenue of ₹ 67,137 million with healthy EBITDA margins of 25%
We expect FY27 to deliver growth, with exports and global biologicals gaining traction backed by customer momentum as well as domestic business is expected to gain from new brand launches.
Once this is demonstrated well with this product, it gives us hope to build a lot more for the next multi-decades, multi-years if I was to say to bring innovation to the market.
Our focus today would be to continue to hold the market share and volume because the margins could always return back when the market swings.

adds.what: Kilo facility at Lodi plant (pharma pipeline) about to be commercialised; Flow MPP commissioned in FY26
Electronic chemicals: a few hundred crore of additional gross block planned

growth.why: FY27 growth is guided only as 'growth for sure', with worst case late single digit to early double digit and no normal-case number; backing is an H2 AgChem export recovery, domestic launches and pharma/biologicals scale-up, with an order book of $1-1.2bn but no specific capacity timing, and utilisation is about 80%.
